journey.name: cached profile header while loading
journey.description:
Verifies that opening Profile straight after a relaunch, while the signed-in profile is still loading, shows the cached name read-only. The edit, copy, share, QR code and tag controls are absent. The full profile then replaces the cached header in place.
Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default), PIN off, and an active Pubky profile with a name and an avatar, created in Bitkit or adopted from Pubky Ring. Profile must have loaded fully once on this install, so the cache records which key the name and avatar belong to; the first steps do that.
A warm network can finish the load before the first inspection, so an "already loaded" result repeats the relaunch once instead of failing. To keep the load running on an emulator, run adb emu network delay gprs and adb emu network speed edge before the first step, and adb emu network delay none and adb emu network speed full after the last; a physical device needs another way to slow its connection. If the load fails instead, the cached header gives way to the retry state (testTag "ProfileRetry"), which is not what this journey covers: relax the throttle and repeat.
Two steps differ from iOS. While the session is still restoring, the profile button opens the Pubky choice screen, which moves on to Profile by itself once the session is back, where iOS shows a bare initialization spinner. Android also checks the cached avatar from a screenshot, because it comes from the Pubky image disk cache, which shows it without the network. See README.md.

actions.action: Wait for the full profile name (testTag "ProfileViewName") and note the name it shows
If the PIN screen appears, unlock the wallet
As soon as the home screen shows, tap the header profile button (testTag "ProfileButton")

If the Pubky choice screen shows first, wait for it to move on to Profile. That is the session restore, which has to finish before the cached header can show. A spinner under the "Profile" title with no name is not that wait: no cached header showed, so report it

Verify the cached profile header (testTag "ProfileCachedHeader") is visible and its name (testTag "ProfileCachedName") matches the name noted before the relaunch. If the full profile name (testTag "ProfileViewName") is already showing, the load finished first: report "already loaded" and repeat from the force-stop step once rather than failing

Verify the cached header is read-only: edit (testTag "ProfileEdit"), copy (testTag "ProfileCopy"), share (testTag "ProfileShare"), the QR code (testTag "ProfileQRCode") and add tag (testTag "ProfileAddTag") are all absent
Take a screenshot and verify the cached header shows the profile's avatar, not the placeholder icon
Wait for the full profile name (testTag "ProfileViewName")
Verify the cached profile header (testTag "ProfileCachedHeader") is gone and the full profile name (testTag "ProfileViewName") matches the cached name
Verify edit (testTag "ProfileEdit") and the QR code (testTag "ProfileQRCode") are visible
